name: spiderman-vscode
description: A local desktop companion that adds a playful 3D Spider-Man presence to your VS Code workspace.

spiderman.physics.enabled.description: Enable the physics simulation (swing, gravity, momentum).

spiderman.swingSpeed.description: Overall speed multiplier for swinging behavior.

spiderman.activityReactions.description: Allow editor activity (save, typing, etc.) to probabilistically influence behavior mood.

spiderman.renderQuality.description: Rendering quality preset. Automatically reduced under performance pressure.

spiderman.maxParticles.description: Maximum number of active particles (webs, dust, sparks).

spiderman.sound.enabled.description: Enable audio. Disabled by default during early testing.

spiderman.interactive.description: Enable interactive mode (click/drag on Spider-Man). Off by default; click-through is the normal mode.

spiderman.clickThrough.description: When true, clicks pass through the overlay to VS Code underneath.

spiderman.maxCharacterSize.description: Upper bound multiplier on character scale at NEAR depth.

spiderman.showWebs.description: Render visible webs for active attachments.

spiderman.debugPhysics.description: Show the debug physics overlay (FPS, velocity, anchor, state, etc.).

scripts.test: node test/integration/protocol.test.js && node test/integration/phase3-window-bounds.test.js && node test/integration/phase4-3d-scene.test.js && node test/integration/phase5-physics.test.js && node test/integration/phase6-web-constraint.test.js && node test/integration/phase7-character.test.js && node test/integration/phase8-animation.test.js && node test/integration/phase9-autonomous-behavior.test.js && node test/integration/phase10-polish.test.js
